notes: Labels generated automatically by pipeline detection, not by independent human annotation. Blind-listen validation was not performed. QA pass rate reflects automated consistency check only. G4 criteria for dual human annotation and blind listening are NOT fully met. Cohen's kappa requires a second independent annotator which we do not have. Renamed annotator from misleading 'auto_whisper' to 'auto_pipeline'. The honest status is CONDITIONAL_PASS pending human validation.
what_we_found: All 124 labels come from automated detection. No independent human annotator was used. This means A1 (label accuracy) cannot be claimed at 95% — it is unverified. The synthetic labels (96 clips) are correct by construction per G3. The 28 real-clip labels need human validation.
